text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'A1 (monthly XGBoost model plus the CAMS unit PV shape and clear-sky index) minus A0 (same model without them), CRPS at days 1 to 10 on the shared half-hours of 2025-07 to 2026-06. Negative is better for A1. Dot: estimate. Line: 99.67% interval (pooled rows) or 95% interval (single Primary), from resampling whole months. The columns hold realised irradiance, so a live service cannot supply them for the first day of lead.'
text.tspan: A1 (monthly XGBoost model plus the CAMS unit PV shape and clear-sky index) minus A0 (same model without them),
CRPS at days 1 to 10 on the shared half-hours of 2025-07 to 2026-06. Negative is better for A1. Dot: estimate.
Line: 99.67% interval (pooled rows) or 95% interval (single Primary), from resampling whole months. The
columns hold realised irradiance, so a live service cannot supply them for the first day of lead.
